notify_critical_encounters.label: Notify when a Critical Encounter opens for registration
notify_critical_encounters.tooltip:
Show one Windows notification (system tray) when a Critical Encounter (including the Forked Tower) opens for registration.
Requires the NotificationMaster plugin.

notify_pot_fates.label: Notify when a pot FATE spawns
notify_pot_fates.tooltip:
Show one Windows notification when Persistent Pots or Pleading Pots spawns.
Requires the NotificationMaster plugin.

notify_when_game_focused.label: Also notify while the game window is focused
notify_when_game_focused.tooltip:
Off: no Windows notification while the game is the foreground window (you can already see it in game).
On: always notify.

test.label: Send test notification
test.tooltip: Send one Windows notification now through NotificationMaster to check that it works (ignores the foreground setting).
test.not_loaded: NotificationMaster is not installed or not enabled.
test.failed: NotificationMaster did not show it (see dalamud.log).

toast.test_body: If you can see this, NotificationMaster is receiving BOCCHI notifications.
